scope: Broaden the optional independent DXF comparator inventory and screen a newly surfaced project for license eligibility; refine only the existing composed comparator gate.

method.kind: Primary-source project, release, license, and Autodesk DXF-reference review with local plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing optional peer comparator checkpoint and latest implementation/research status
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: findings/subplans totals and deferred external J items
method.limitations: Repository and release statements are not runtime conformance evidence. netDxf is archived and its declared feature matrix is not independently executed. Sea-DXF Core's project statements are not evaluated as implementation behavior; its own license declaration excludes it from the open-source comparator set. No geometry or consumer result was produced.

evidence.observed: The signed/tagged v3.0.1 release at commit 3d24d7c describes ASCII and binary DXF read/write for AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032. The README documents ordinary 2D/mesh entities, says ACAD_TABLE is imported as INSERT, excludes REGION/SURFACE/3DSOLID, and GitHub marks the repository archived/read-only since 2023-10-11.
doesNotEstablish: runtime conformance for any entity, version, or mode
complete handle, owner, table, XDATA, or unknown-tag preservation
DWG support or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep it as a pinned historical optional structural DXF comparator at the composed gate only, if already available. Stratify ACAD_TABLE separately from INSERT and count peer skips/diagnostics; do not add a dependency or per-slice runtime.

evidence.observed: The project README calls Sea-DXF Core pre-1.0 and states that its currently visible source is under a proprietary license, with no permission to use, copy, modify, or redistribute implied by visibility.
evidence.planUse: Exclude it from open-source evidence and implementation comparisons; do not copy code, schemas, samples, or tests. Revisit only after an explicit license/release change.

evidence.observed: Autodesk's current group-code reference and OCS explanation show that coordinates with the same numeric groups can have entity-specific coordinate systems; planar entities may use OCS and 3D/non-planar entities may use WCS, with extrusion/elevation relevant to conversion.
doesNotEstablish: that peer readers expose normalized WCS values
that matching raw coordinates prove matching geometry
the result of any local or peer OCS implementation
evidence.planUse: At the composed comparator gate, compare WCS geometry only for vectors with an independent expected normal/elevation and exercised OCS conversion. Otherwise compare raw typed coordinates and extrusion/elevation separately and mark geometry unscored.

readinessRefinement: Treat netDxf v3.0.1 as an archived historical ASCII/binary DXF baseline, not a maintained peer or mandatory runtime.
Use the optional netDxf route only at the composed gate and only when already available; keep it outside the fast per-slice loop.
Separate ordinary INSERT from ACAD_TABLE and keep modeler/ACIS carrier semantics outside netDxf's documented capability.
Exclude Sea-DXF Core while its project declares a proprietary license; source visibility alone is not open-source eligibility.
Do not equate raw OCS tuple equality with WCS geometry equality; compare transformed geometry only against independent expected values.
